items.text: Mass spectrometry and capillary electrophoresis application workflows that redefine what is achievable

From routine testing to the most complex analytical experiments, our research and development teams are constantly innovating so that you have the tools you need to elevate your work in new and innovative ways.

SCIEX technologies deliver unique application workflows that redefine your lab. Our mass spectrometers, capillary electrophoresis instruments, front-end HPLC systems and software portfolio are designed by scientists like you with your applications in mind. Together with easy data interpretation, technical expertise, application workflow optimization and system service, we work closely with you to discover those answers.

With SCIEX you get more than industry leading technologies. We value working in partnership, bringing a global network of expert scientists and workflow enhancement specialists to guide you and ensure you have the best data possible, and can react quickly.

With the right technology, critical decisions become much easier. Whether you specialize in life science research, drug discovery and development, clinical diagnostics, forensics or food and environmental testing, SCIEX can help you turn data into answers that lead to insights.
It’s what we do together that sets us apart
